convention: act_occ, act_virt: 0-based canonical MO indices; active arrays are ordered A_o then A_v (each ascending). mo_coeff[mu][p] (AO mu, MO p), spherical cc-pVDZ. v_eff in chemist notation (tu|vw), spatial, restricted. f_tu = h_tu + sum_I [2(tu|ii) - (ti|iu)]; t_dc = sum_{k in A_o} [2 vt_tu,kk - vt_tk,ku] (no Sigma), vt = v_eff - v; h = f - t_dc. sigma_bar = 1/2 [S_tu(e_t) + S_tu(e_u)] at e = sigma_energies (mean-field). CAS energies exclude the constant E_0; exc_singlet = E(S1) - E(S0), exc_triplet = E(T1) - E(S0), spin from <S^2> of the dense CASCI vectors.
screenings: bare: v; cRPA: W(0) with A_o -> A_v removed from chi; cRPAph: W(0) only on particle-hole (ov|ov) elements, v elsewhere
